messages:
sara: Quick UX vote — attaching the mock for the first-run snackbars + progress microcopy. https://img.redwood.dev/ux/onboard-snack-1.png matt: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) make copy scannable 2) keep actions minimal. I think 'Setup complete' > 'You're all set' for concision. gina: prefer 'You're all set' — it's friendlier on a first-run. Also: make the toast dismissible after 6–8s and add a 'View sample project' CTA (primary) so users can jump in. lee: implementation note: ephemeral toasts with action are easiest. If we make them dismissible we need to ensure they don't overlap the top nav. Also watch scroll anchors when 'View sample project' navigates — use `history.pushState` rather than full reload. lee: code sketch: ``` // minimal aria

You're all set — open your sample project

``` amar: a11y: role="status" + aria-live="polite" is good. Don't rely on color alone for success state — add an icon and clear text. Keyboard focus order: after toast appears, don't trap focus; focus should remain in the page, but CTA must be tabbable. Also ensure 4.5:1 contrast on text. tess: from recent interviews, users were confused by 'Add sample data' language. They didn't realize it's a prebuilt project. Suggest using 'sample project' or 'demo workspace' in copy. sara: OK — proposing 2 variants for A/B: A: "Setup complete — open your sample project" B: "You're ready — explore sample projects" Which do folks prefer for primary CTA labeling? Also thinking about keeping a persistent mini-checklist in the left rail until they open a sample. matt: pick B. Short and action-oriented. gina: +1 B. Also recommend the persistent mini-checklist be collapsible (default expanded) so it doesn't feel heavy. lee: note: if the user has slow network or offline, fallbacks: ``` if (!navigator.onLine) showOfflineToast('Project saved locally, sync when online') ``` Keep toasts retryable. amar: one more: for the progress stepper, add `aria-describedby` linking to the step status text (so screen readers announce progress). And test with NVDA. sara: great feedback — I'll update the comps (snack timing to 6s, aria notes added, copy = variant B), upload assets later today and tag everyone for a quick pass. Thanks! :heart: deploy-bot: design-update uploaded: https://figma.redwood.dev/file/xyz sara: added final mocks in the figma link, will A/B ship to 10% with analytics events: `onboard.toast_shown`, `onboard.sample_opened`. If any objections shout now, otherwise I'll merge the copy. matt: sounds good. no objections from my side.
